interface.title: ANN Streamflow Prediction Dashboard (Streamlit)
interface.field: Hydrology / machine learning for daily river discharge (streamflow) forecasting
interface.stage_of_work: Post-training model evaluation and selection: comparing finished runs, checking diagnostics and running ad hoc queries on stored results
interface.what_it_is_for: Browse a daily discharge record and its chronological 80/20 train/test split, then compare 25 pre-trained neural-network configurations (5 activations x 5 optimizers) by R², RMSE, MAE and RME, inspect fit, residuals and loss curves for chosen models, and run SQL on the bundled results database.

data.note: Everything comes from the bundled read-only streamflow_results.db (tables raw_data, model_configurations, training_results, training_logs, predictions): 13,874 daily discharge values from 1985-01-06 to 2022-12-31 and the results of 25 trained models. No upload anywhere. The API Demo page needs a FastAPI server on localhost:8000, which was not running. The External Data page calls the live USGS Water Services API, which this server cannot reach.

features.specific: Activation Functions and Optimizers multiselects on Model Comparison filter the Results Table, the R² Test by Configuration bars, the Activation vs Optimizer heatmap, the RMSE vs R² scatter and the Training Time chart; the Best Model banner (r2_test maximum of the filtered rows) names ELU_Adam while ELU and Adam are selected. Clearing every activation empties the table and shows an argmax error

read the filtered results table

hover scatter points for the full metric set of one run
